record.question:
Lala and Dova can do a piece of work in 45 days and 40 days respectively. They began the work
       together, but Lala leaves after 9 days. In how many days will Dova finish the remaining work?
record.explanation: Together their rate is 1/45+1/40=17/360 per day. In 9 days they finish 17/40, leaving 23/40. Dova alone needs (23/40)/(1/40)=23 days.
